_comment: LOCKED for the exercise. Illustrative, rounded, frozen. Do not edit during the workshop.
feature: AI study assistant for university courses
incident: Went viral during finals week. Traffic is 5x normal and climbing.

constraints._comment: SLO set from measured data: the ladder reaches it at rung 4 on a 4-core laptop and rung 5 on a 2-core Codespace. Re-measure on your own hardware before the session -- latency is hardware-dependent, cost is not.

traffic.note: Monthly cost is projected from requests_per_day x 30. Projecting from peak QPS held 24/7 would imply 116M requests a month, which is not what a campus tool looks like.

prices._comment: USD per 1M tokens, plus a flat monthly cost per replica. cached_input is the discounted rate for tokens served from the prefix cache -- 10% of the normal input rate, which is roughly what commercial providers charge.

google:mistral-small-2503._comment: USD per 1M tokens; verify current Google pricing before the event. Cloud Run infrastructure is separate.
